## Service: forms (Forms API)

Documentation for forms API

### Get Forms
GET /forms/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/forms/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/get-forms | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/get-forms.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: forms.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")
- skip number (e.g. 0)
- limit number (default: 10; e.g. 20) - Limit Per Page records count. will allow maximum up to 50 and default will be 10
- type string (e.g. "folder")

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- forms object[]
  - id string
  - name string
  - locationId string
- total number - Total number of forms

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Get Forms Submissions
GET /forms/submissions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/forms/submissions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/get-forms-submissions | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/get-forms-submissions.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: forms.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")
- page number (default: 1) - Page No. By default it will be 1
- limit number (default: 20) - Limit Per Page records count. will allow maximum up to 100 and default will be 20
- formId string (e.g. "jjusM6EOngDExnbo2DbU") - Filter submission by form id
- q string (e.g. "john@deo.com") - Filter by contactId, name, email or phone no.
- startAt string (e.g. "2020-11-14") - Get submission by starting of this date. By default it will be same date of last month(YYYY-MM-DD).
- endAt string (e.g. "2020-12-14") - Get submission by ending of this date. By default it will be current date(YYYY-MM-DD).

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- submissions object[]
  - id string
  - contactId string
  - createdAt string
  - formId string
  - name string
  - email string
  - others object
    - __submissions_other_field__ string
    - __custom_field_id__ string
    - eventData object
      - fbc string
      - fbp string
      - page object
        - url string
        - title string
      - type string
      - domain string
      - medium string
      - source string
      - version string
      - adSource string
      - mediumId string
      - parentId string
      - referrer string
      - fbEventId string
      - timestamp number
      - parentName string
      - fingerprint string
      - pageVisitType string
      - contactSessionIds object (nullable)
        - ids string[] (nullable)
    - fieldsOriSequance string[]
- meta object
  - total number
  - currentPage number
  - nextPage number (nullable)
  - prevPage number (nullable)

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Upload files to custom fields
POST /forms/upload-custom-files
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/forms/upload-custom-files
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/upload-to-custom-fields | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/forms/upload-to-custom-fields.md

Post the necessary fields for the API to upload files. The files need to be a buffer with the key "< custom_field_id >_< file_id >". <br /> Here custom field id is the ID of your custom field and file id is a randomly generated id (or uuid) <br /> There is support for multiple file uploads as well. Have multiple fields in the format mentioned.<br />File size is limited to 50 MB.<br /><br /> The allowed file types are: <br/> <ul><li>PDF</li><li>DOCX</li><li>DOC</li><li>JPG</li><li>JPEG</li><li>PNG</li><li>GIF</li><li>CSV</li><li>XLSX</li><li>XLS</li><li>MP4</li><li>MPEG</li><li>ZIP</li><li>RAR</li><li>TXT</li><li>SVG</li></ul> <br /><br /> The API will return the updated contact object.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: forms.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: forms.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- contactId* string (e.g. "dtEv6KtI27yF92YPm3Zz") - Contact ID to upload the file to.
- locationId* string (e.g. "quXmPY59n1zgGBabY1bZ") - Location ID of the contact.

Request body (required) (multipart/form-data):
- (no schema)

Response 200 (Successful response): no body

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
